scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.format: npm run db:format --workspace backend && prettier --write package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json docker-compose.yml README.md backend/package.json backend/prisma.config.ts backend/tsconfig*.json backend/vitest.config.ts "backend/src/**/*.ts" "backend/test/**/*.ts" frontend/package.json frontend/tsconfig.json frontend/vite.config.ts "frontend/**/*.{ts,tsx,css,html}"
